title: Viking woman’s clothes preserved by her jewellery for 1,300 years
summary_full: Danish archaeologists discovered rare Viking textile remains near Varde.  Corrosion from jewelry preserved these ancient wool and linen fragments.  This discovery offers a rare glimpse into Viking dress from 1,300 years ago.  Researchers will analyze the fibers and teeth for more information.  Dating the textiles will reveal if ornaments were new or inherited.
